Import required dataset
```{r}
library(readr) # helps with reading tsv files
library(dplyr)
```

Global variables
```{r}
dataset_path <- "/Users/sorenbasnet/Documents/Github/PYTHON/STAT_443/tcga_brca/data/"
```

Import clinical datasets
```{r}

clinical_dataset  <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path,"clinical/clinical.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
familial_dataset  <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "clinical/follow_up.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
pathology_dataset <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "clinical/pathology_detail.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(pathology_dataset)
exposure_dataset  <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "clinical/exposure.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(exposure_dataset)
follow_up_dataset <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "clinical/follow_up.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

```

Import biospecimen datasets 
```{r}

aliquot_dataset <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "biospecimen/aliquot.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
analyte_dataset <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "biospecimen/analyte.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
portion_dataset <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "biospecimen/portion.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sample_dataset  <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "biospecimen/sample.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
slide_dataset   <- read_tsv(file.path(dataset_path, "biospecimen/slide.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

```


Number of cases 
```{r}
common_col_names <- Reduce(intersect,
  list(
    colnames(clinical_dataset),
    colnames(familial_dataset), 
    colnames(pathology_dataset), 
    colnames(exposure_dataset), 
    colnames(follow_up_dataset), 
    colnames(aliquot_dataset), 
    colnames(analyte_dataset), 
    colnames(portion_dataset), 
    colnames(sample_dataset), 
    colnames(slide_dataset)
  )
)

print(common_col_names)


# same thing can be done as 

# Source - https://stackoverflow.com/a/67691108
# Posted by Jonas
# Retrieved 2026-02-07, License - CC BY-SA 4.0

dfList <- list(clinical_dataset, familial_dataset, pathology_dataset, exposure_dataset, follow_up_dataset, aliquot_dataset, analyte_dataset, portion_dataset, sample_dataset, slide_dataset)
dfColList <- lapply(dfList,names)
commonCols <- Reduce(intersect,dfColList)
 
print(commonCols)
```

clinical_dataset <- clinical_dataset %>% filter(grepl("United States", demographic.country_of_residence_at_enrollment))
clinical_dataset[clinical_dataset == "'--"] <- NA

Exploring the common columns dfs share  and combining all the clinical and biospecimen datasets
```{r}
head(clinical_dataset[c("project.project_id", "cases.case_id", "cases.submitter_id")]) # case id seems to be primary key for per patient case

length(unique(clinical_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098
length(unique(familial_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1096
length(unique(pathology_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1096
length(unique(exposure_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1
length(unique(follow_up_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1096
length(unique(aliquot_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098
length(unique(analyte_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098
length(unique(portion_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098
length(unique(sample_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098
length(unique(slide_dataset$cases.case_id)) # 1098

# first drop project.project_id and cases.submitter_id from every dataset except clinical_dataset 

familial_dataset = subset(familial_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
pathology_dataset = subset(pathology_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
exposure_dataset = subset(exposure_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
follow_up_dataset = subset(follow_up_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
aliquot_dataset = subset(aliquot_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
analyte_dataset = subset(analyte_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
portion_dataset = subset(portion_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
sample_dataset = subset(sample_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))
slide_dataset = subset(slide_dataset, select = -c(project.project_id, cases.submitter_id))


# combine all of the df 

df <- clinical_dataset %>%
  full_join(familial_dataset, by = "cases.case_id") %>%
  full_join(pathology_dataset, by = "cases.case_id") %>%
  full_join(exposure_dataset, by = "cases.case_id") %>%
  full_join(follow_up_dataset, by = "cases.case_id") 

df

```
